name: Crown of Desire
source:
In a kingdom swallowed by eternal night, a princess is determined to regain the throne stolen by a treacherous usurper. As her faithful squire, it falls to you to unseat the false king. Will you seduce women to fuel her dark magic and take her revenge, or will you seek allies to save your princess from falling into corruption? The choice is yours. Whether driven by chivalrous love for your lady or by your own base lust and ambition, the future of the kingdom hinges on your decisions.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/crown-of-desire-103524289]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在一个被永夜吞噬的王国里，一位公主决心夺回被奸诈篡位者偷走的王位。作为她忠实的侍从，你有责任推翻假国王。你会引诱女人来助长她的黑暗魔法并为她复仇，还是会寻求盟友来拯救你的公主免遭腐败？选择权在你。无论是出于对女士的侠义之爱，还是出于你自己的卑鄙欲望和野心，王国的未来都取决于你的决定。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/crown-of-desire-103524289]Patreon[/url]]
